title: Balaiada
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Balaiada", at revision 1370430053, opens: "The Balaiada was a social revolt between 1838 and 1841 in the interior of the Province of Maranhão, Brazil." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2880458, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "social revolt between 1838 and 1841 in the interior of the Province of Maranhão, Brazil, so named because its leader made baskets (balaio) for a living". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
